'''Lorta''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located on the [[Cerean Reach/Legends|Cerean Reach]], near [[Jiroch-Reslia]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It was was home to the violent and expansionist [[Lortan]]s.

==History==
[[File:Battle_of_Sarapin_4.png|thumb|left|180px|[[Battle above Lorta]].]]

A [[Battle above Lorta|battle]] occurred in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of Lorta during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Republic forces attacked the [[D-1Z prototype bomber]] on its maiden voyage but Imperial forces successfully defended the [[Bomber/Legends|bomber]].<ref name="TOR" />

For centuries, [[Lortan Fanatics|religious fanatics]] from Lorta threatened the neighbouring sectors.<ref name="JTaT">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030130jtptan|text=J't'p'tan: Temples and Tybis}}</ref> They believed that someday a Man-[[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] would sweep evil from [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="RS25">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 25|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 25]]</ref>

During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], expansionist Lortan Fanatics eventually launched their murderous crusade, knows as the [[Reslian Purge]]. They swept across twelve [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] and destroyed everything in their path.<ref name="GG12">''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]''</ref> The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] eventually interceded them and the Lortans were finally stopped in a series of battles in which [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]] participated.<ref name="RS25" />
